description: Fetch any public web page and get clean readable text for LLM input: title, meta description, language, canonical URL, H1-H3 headings, main body text with navigation, scripts and boilerplate removed, and the page's outbound links. Use for web scraping, article reading, research and RAG ingestion. Costs $0.002 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
